data.name: AboutText
data.comment: {0} is the product name, {1} its version, {2} the project address.

data.name: AboutTitle
data.comment: {0} is the product name.

data.name: AgentNoAck
data.value: The agent did not acknowledge the drag

data.name: AgentNotFound
data.value: No agent on the remote computer

data.name: AgentReady
data.comment: {0} is the version of the agent, such as 0.3.0.

data.name: CancelledReason
data.comment: {0} is a text from the agent, already in this language.

data.name: CannotConnect
data.comment: {0} is an error text from Windows.

data.name: CannotReadFile
data.comment: {0} is a file path, {1} an error text from Windows.

data.name: ConnectedTo
data.comment: {0} is a computer name.

data.name: ConnectingTo
data.comment: {0} is a computer name.

data.name: CredentialsForgotten
data.value: Saved credentials for {0} forgotten; the next connection asks for them.
data.comment: {0} is a computer name.

data.name: DisconnectedCode
data.comment: {0} is a number.

data.name: DisconnectedReason
data.comment: {0} is a text from the Remote Desktop control, in the language of Windows.

data.name: DisconnectedSessionClosed
data.value: Disconnected: the session was closed from the remote computer

data.name: Dragging
data.comment: {0} is a number of files and folders.

data.name: DropFailedNoDetail
data.value: Drop failed: no detail from the agent.

data.name: DropFailedNotSent
data.value: Drop failed: the message could not be sent to the agent.

data.name: DropFailedReason
data.comment: {0} is a text from the agent, already in this language.

data.name: DropRefusedAgentWaiting
data.value: Drop refused: the RdpDrop agent has not answered yet.

data.name: DropRefusedByAgent
data.value: Drop refused: the agent refused the drag.

data.name: DropRefusedNoAgent
data.value: Drop refused: the RdpDrop agent is not running in the remote session.

data.name: DropRefusedNoLiveDrag
data.value: Drop refused: the drag did not start in the session. Drag the files again.

data.name: DropRefusedReason
data.comment: {0} is a text from the agent or from the client, already in this language.

data.name: DropZoneBanner
data.value: Drop here to send the files into the session

data.name: DroppedOn
data.comment: {0} is a window title, {1} is the text of EffectCopy or EffectLink.

data.name: EffectCopy
data.comment: Shown inside DroppedOn.

data.name: EffectLink
data.comment: Shown inside DroppedOn.

data.name: EmptyWindowHint
data.value: No session is open. Use File, Open .rdp or File, Recent to start one.

data.name: FatalError
data.value: Fatal error {0} in the Remote Desktop control
data.comment: {0} is a number.

data.name: FileDoesNotRedirectDrives
data.value: This .rdp file does not redirect drives: drops will not work.

data.name: FileHasNoAddress
data.value: The file {0} does not name a computer to connect to (no "full address" line).
data.comment: {0} is a file path. "full address" is a setting name of .rdp files: keep it in English.

data.name: ForgetCredentialsQuestion
data.value:
Forget the credentials that Windows saved for {0}?
The next connection asks for them again. The open session is not affected.
data.comment: {0} is a computer name.

data.name: ForgetCredentialsTip
data.value: RdpDrop never saves credentials. Windows saves them when you tick "Remember me" in its credential prompt.

data.name: FullScreenNeedsConnection
data.value: Full screen is available once connected.

data.name: LogOffFailedNoDetail
data.value: Log off failed: no detail from the agent.

data.name: LogOffFailedReason
data.comment: {0} is a text from the agent, already in this language.

data.name: LogOffNoAnswer
data.value: The agent did not answer the log off request.

data.name: LogOffNotSent
data.value: Log off failed: the request could not be sent to the agent.

data.name: LogOffQuestion
data.value: This closes your Windows session on the server and ends the applications running there. Continue?

data.name: LoggedOnTo
data.comment: {0} is a computer name.

data.name: MenuForgetCredentialsFor
data.comment: {0} is a computer name.

data.name: MenuScaleAuto
data.comment: {0} is a percentage, such as 125 %.

data.name: NoSavedCredentials
data.comment: {0} is a computer name.

data.name: NothingAccepted
data.value: Nothing under the cursor accepted the files.

data.name: OpenDialogFilter
data.comment: Keep the part after the bar as it is.

data.name: PathDevice
data.value: "{0}" is a device path. Only files on a local drive letter can be dropped.
data.comment: {0} is a path.

data.name: PathDotSegment
data.value: "{0}" contains a "." or ".." segment. Only normalized full paths can be dropped.
data.comment: {0} is a path.

data.name: PathDriveRelative
data.value: "{0}" is relative to the current folder of its drive. Only full paths such as C:\folder can be dropped.
data.comment: {0} is a path.

data.name: PathInvalidCharacters
data.value: "{0}" contains characters that are not allowed in a file name.
data.comment: {0} is a path.

data.name: PathNetwork
data.value: "{0}" is a network (UNC) path. Only files on a local drive letter can be dropped, because the remote session reaches them through drive redirection.
data.comment: {0} is a path.

data.name: PathRelative
data.value: "{0}" is a relative path. Only full paths that start with a drive letter, such as C:\, can be dropped.
data.comment: {0} is a path.

data.name: Reconnecting
data.comment: {0} is a computer name, {1} a number.

data.name: SessionSeesNoDrive
data.value: The session sees no redirected drive: drops will not work. Turn on drives under Local Resources.

data.name: SettingAppliesNextConnection
data.comment: {0} is the text of SettingScaleFactor, SettingMonitors or SettingWindowsKeys.

data.name: SettingAppliesWhenConnecting
data.comment: {0} is the text of SettingScaleFactor, SettingMonitors or SettingWindowsKeys.

data.name: SettingMonitors
data.comment: Start of a sentence, used as {0} in SettingAppliesWhenConnecting, SettingAppliesNextConnection and SettingReconnectQuestion.

data.name: SettingReconnectQuestion
data.value:
{0} applies to a new connection to {1}.
Reconnect now?
data.comment: {0} is the text of SettingScaleFactor, SettingMonitors or SettingWindowsKeys, {1} a computer name.

data.name: SettingScaleFactor
data.comment: Start of a sentence, used as {0} in SettingAppliesWhenConnecting, SettingAppliesNextConnection and SettingReconnectQuestion.

data.name: SettingWindowsKeys
data.comment: Start of a sentence, used as {0} in SettingAppliesWhenConnecting, SettingAppliesNextConnection and SettingReconnectQuestion.

data.name: TabDisconnected
data.comment: {0} is a computer name, shown in a tab.

data.name: UnexpectedError
data.comment: {0} is an error text, {1} a folder path.

data.name: WindowUnderCursor
data.comment: Used as {0} in DroppedOn when the window has no name.
